title: ICAR develops India's 1st T2T reference genome of pigeonpea (Arhar/Tur)
summary: Variety **'Asha'**; 752.65 million base pairs across 92 contigs; all 11 chromosomes (11 centromeres + 22 telomeres); builds on ICAR-NIPB's earlier work.

items: Variety **'Asha'**; 752.65 million base pairs across 92 contigs; all 11 chromosomes (11 centromeres + 22 telomeres); builds on ICAR-NIPB's earlier work.
Part of Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses (2025-26 to 2030-31) — target 35 MT pulse production by 2030-31.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Pigeonpea = India's 2nd most important pulse; genome variety 'Asha'; mission target 35 MT by 2030-31.
